main.description: Who a feature flag is on for, keyed by the flag's key. Any gate that matches turns it on. Written only by the root account into the staff space.

enabled.description: False turns it off for everyone and keeps the gates below for when it's back on. Missing means true.

everyone.description: On for every visitor, signed in or not.

percentage.description: On for this share of signed-in accounts. An account stays in as the share grows.

groups.description: Record keys of the computer.localnetwork.staff.group records it's on for.
